messages.text: What can I quickly make with milk and strawberries that expire today?

You can prepare a quick 5-minute **Strawberry Greek Yogurt Compote Bowl**! You also have Greek yogurt and sourdough in your pantry. Alternatively, blend them with a dash of honey into a chilled breakfast smoothie, saving $8.28 in potential food waste.
My avocados are already ripe, how do I prevent them from spoiling before Friday?

Move them immediately to your refrigerator's crisper drawer. Cold temperatures slow ethylene ripening significantly. If cut in half, keep the pit in place, brush with olive oil or lemon juice, and store in an airtight container.
